I ran every query below and got an answer, apart from T11 and T14, which I only checked by running (not against the data). I checked the T1, T3, T4, T12 and T13 answers by hand against the data, and they matched.

- **T10:** it prints as a map with keyword keys, `{:db 3 :api 1 :worker 1}`, because every map key in qlang is a keyword.
- **T12:** the answer is 204.91.
- **T13:** the answer is Birch 109.97, then Acme 104.96.
- **Shell note:** queries that begin with `/` need `MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1` in front of `qlang` in Git Bash.

T1: /data/users | filter ~(allOf /active (at :email | coalesce "" | lower | endsWith "@example.com")) | count
T2: /data/users | filter ~(/roles | map ~(lower) | contains "admin") | map ~(/name) | sort ~(lower)
T3: /data/users | groupBy ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :country | coalesce "unknown") | map ~(count)
T4: /data/users | map ~(at :profile | coalesce {} | at :age) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 2
T5: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(/labels) | flat | map ~(/name | lower) | distinct | sort
T6: sort ~([(/comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~({:number /number :assignee (at :assignee | coalesce {} | at :login)})
T7: filter ~(/state | eq "open") | map ~(at :assignee) | filter ~(ne null) | groupBy ~(/login) | map ~(count)
T8: :dev /devDependencies | /dependencies | union dev | entries | filter ~(/1 | startsWith "^") | map ~([(/0 | print | drop 1) (/1)] | join "@") | sort
T9: /services | filter ~(allOf (at :enabled | eq true) (/port | gt 8000)) | map ~(/name | lower) | sort | join ","
T10: lines | filter ~(split " " | /1 | eq "ERROR") | groupBy ~(split " " | /2) | map ~(count)
T11: lines | filter ~(contains "ms=") | map ~(split " " | filter ~(startsWith "ms=") | /0 | drop 3 | parseJson) | avg | round 1
T12: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | map ~({:c /1 :s (/5 | lower) :q (/3 | parseJson) :p (/4 | parseJson)} | {:c /c :s /s :t (mulOf /q /p)}) | filter ~(/s | eq "shipped") | map ~(/t) | sum | round 2
T13: lines | drop 1 | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(/4 | ne "") | map ~({:c /1 :s (/5 | lower) :q (/3 | parseJson) :p (/4 | parseJson)} | {:c /c :s /s :t (mulOf /q /p)}) | filter ~(/s | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(/c) | entries | map ~({:customer (/0 | print | drop 1) :total (/1 | map ~(/t) | sum | round 2)}) | sort ~([(/total | desc)]) | take 2
T14: ["Banana","apple","Cherry","banana","fig","APPLE","date","kiwi","Fig","elderberry"] | map ~(lower) | distinct | sort ~([(count | desc) (/)]) | join "-"
